projects.name: Project Manager
details: PWC Oct’24 – Feb’25
Demonstrated strong leadership skills by successfully guiding diverse teams at Adobe and Microsoft. Throughout my tenure, I've overseen the entire project
lifecycle, from formulating business cases to project initiation, planning, and execution. My commitment to ongoing enhancement prompted me to closely
monitor essential metrics such as KPIs, compliance, and risk factors. I prioritized transparent communication by consistently providing stakeholders with
weekly updates on project progress and developments.
• Monitoring and reporting on project progress, identifying potential challenges, and proactively implementing solutions to keep projects on track and
aligned with business goals.
• Overseeing multiple programs, aligning them with corporate strategy through project goal setting and charter development.
• Coordinating the project portfolio to support strategic aims by defining project parameters and deliverables.
• Leading cross-functional projects across multiple business verticals, driving initiatives, and ensuring alignment with corporate objectives.
• Managing end-to-end project lifecycles, from planning and resource allocation to execution and post-implementation reviews, ensuring timely
delivery and achievement of key milestones.
• Developing and implementing project management frameworks and best practices to optimize efficiency, mitigate risks, and enhance overall program
performance.
• Facilitating seamless communication and coordination between various departments, fostering collaboration, and driving successful project outcomes
• Leading automation initiatives and supervising full-cycle delivery of technical solutions via timeline planning, resource coordination, budget oversight,
and milestone monitoring.
• Tracking and addressing project challenges using risk documentation, escalating urgent impediments to ensure on-schedule delivery.
• Managing project uncertainties and issues via structured risk tools, promptly informing stakeholders of critical concerns for timely completion.
